name: Camborne Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Trelawny Parish. Open Tue and Thu for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Cornwall Council Allotments - Camborne
short_description: Cornwall Council allotment sites in Camborne area
description: Cornwall Council manages sites including Treswithian
image: and Dolcoath Road. Plots from £30/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage sheds.

name: Camborne Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run garden behind Camborne Library. Grows seasonal vegetables with surplus shared among volunteers. Open Wed and Sat mornings during growing season.

name: Tehidy Country Park Community Orchards
short_description: Historic orchard with apple and pear trees for public picking
description: Community orchard in Tehidy Country Park with heritage apple varieties. Open for public picking during harvest season (Sept-Oct). Maintained by Cornwall Council volunteers.
